propositions: The bugfix-size gate's not-pinned arm returns an affirmative 'mismatch' verdict when a plan-review attestation is signed by a developer environment not in trusted_environments.yaml, blocking large bug fixes that carry passing local reviews.

No executable path exists for a contributor to obtain a prod-attested plan review because the opcert service has no client in the repo, cannot persist signatures, and requires a production secret guard header.
The gate rejects plan-review attestations solely on signing environment provenance (source of certification) rather than on the fact of completed review or attestation lifecycle validity.
Subject binding (ticket_id and kind matching) must be re-asserted explicitly after removing verify_opcert, since opcert_from_record only decodes and compute_validity checks no ticket id.
The attestation check was redesigned to gate only on the fact of a completed, well-formed, lifecycle-valid plan-review attestation rather than on the DSSE principal's presence in the pinned keyring.
